ShortDescription.Value: Unsquare your city! Deform your buildings to fit any plot, angle or slope.

Publish.LongDescription:
Unsquare lets you reshape any building. Taper, skew, twist, raise or lean buildings so they fit odd plots, angled streets and slopes.
**The change is only visual.** The building keeps its residents, jobs, level and upkeep, and its lot keeps its size and zone cells.
**Features**
- **Reshape the whole lot.** The building, its props, paths, paving and grass all follow. - **Terrain follows.** Raise or lower the bottom and the ground follows, or keep it flat. - **Fit to ground.** Sets the building onto the slope with one click. - **Align to neighbours.** Turns a side to the next road or building, or levels it with their ground. - **Undo and redo** for every change. - **Saved with your city.**
**How to use**
1. Click the Unsquare button next to the underground toggle. 2. Click a building, then a corner, edge or side. 3. Drag the arrows to move it, or drag the handle itself to move it sideways. 4. Right-click to step back.
A small window above the building has more tools: terrain, fit to ground, align to neighbours and reset.
**Limitations**
- The ground is only shaped inside the original rectangular lot. - Props move and turn with the building but don't bend. - Lights and other effects don't move yet. - Only buildings with a lot can be reshaped.
**Recommended mods** (not required): **Move It**, **Find It** and **Anarchy** work well alongside Unsquare for placing and fine-tuning buildings.
**Coming from FlexIt:** back up your save, keep FlexIt active, add Unsquare and load the city. Click Options → Unsquare → Settings → Import FlexIt buildings, then save, and FlexIt can be removed. Tapered and skewed buildings keep their shape; curved ones become straight.
**Before uninstalling:** reset all your reshaped buildings (Alt+Shift+Delete) and save, or they can't be restored.
**Credits:** inspired by Flex It by Root Of Business. Unsquare is an independent implementation and contains no code from Flex It.
**Disclaimer:** Unsquare is an unofficial fan-made mod. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Colossal Order or Paradox Interactive. Cities: Skylines II is a trademark of its respective owners.
